cases.candidate_script:
snapshot() { ( cd root || exit; /usr/bin/find . -mindepth 1 -printf '%P %y %l\n' | LC_ALL=C /usr/bin/sort; /usr/bin/find . -type f -exec /usr/bin/sha256sum {} + | LC_ALL=C /usr/bin/sort ); }
snapshot > "$HOME/payload-before"
unset PAYLOAD_INSTALLER
export PAYLOAD_REPO="$PWD/repo" PAYLOAD_ROOT="$PWD/root"
payload install tiny > "$HOME/payload-install.out" 2> "$HOME/payload-install.err"
install_rc=$?
printf 'install=%s\n' "$install_rc"
if [ -f root/usr/share/payload-image-tiny/message ] && [ ! -L root/usr/share/payload-image-tiny/message ] && /usr/bin/cmp -s "$HOME/payload-expected" root/usr/share/payload-image-tiny/message; then echo file=exact; else echo file=wrong; fi
if [ -f root/var/lib/bl-pkg/installed/tiny ] && /usr/bin/grep -Eq '^txn=[^[:space:]]+$' root/var/lib/bl-pkg/installed/tiny; then echo state=txn; else echo state=missing; fi
if [ "$install_rc" -ne 0 ]; then echo 'CONTROL-FAILED install did not complete' >&2; exit 98; fi
payload remove tiny > "$HOME/payload-remove.out" 2> "$HOME/payload-remove.err"
printf 'remove=%s\n' "$?"
if /usr/bin/grep -Fxq 'payload: removed tiny' "$HOME/payload-remove.out"; then echo message=present; else echo message=missing; fi
snapshot > "$HOME/payload-after"
if /usr/bin/cmp -s "$HOME/payload-before" "$HOME/payload-after"; then echo root=restored; else echo root=changed; /usr/bin/diff -u "$HOME/payload-before" "$HOME/payload-after" >&2 || :; fi

state=txn
remove=0
message=present
